# Webflow

Webflow is a no-code website design and hosting platform, letting users build responsive sites, launch online stores, and maintain content without coding

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/webflow/.

## Actions

- **Create Webflow Collection Item**: This tool creates a new item in a specified webflow collection.
- **Delete Webflow Collection Item**: This tool allows you to delete a specific item from a collection in webflow.
- **Get Collection Details** (read-only): Retrieves a specific collection by its id from a webflow site.
- **Get Collection Item** (read-only): This tool retrieves a specific item from a webflow collection.
- **Get Item Inventory** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current inventory levels for a specific item in a webflow collection.
- **Get Order Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific order in webflow.
- **Get Webflow Site Information** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific webflow site.
- **List Collection Items** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of items from a specified collection in webflow.
- **List Form Submissions** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of form submissions for a specific webflow site.
- **List Pages** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all pages for a specified webflow site.
- **List Webflow Collections** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all collections for a given webflow site.
- **List Webflow Orders** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all orders for a specified webflow site using the get /sites/{site id}/orders endpoint.
- **List Webflow Sites** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all webflow sites accessible to the authenticated user.
- **Publish Webflow Site**: This tool publishes a webflow site, making all staged changes live.
- **Refund Order**: This tool allows you to refund a webflow e-commerce order.
- **Update Item Inventory**: This tool allows you to update the inventory levels of a specific sku item in your webflow e-commerce site by either setting the inventory…
- **Update Order**: This tool allows updating specific fields of an existing order in webflow.
- **Update Webflow Collection Item**: This tool allows updating an existing item in a webflow collection using the patch /collections/{collection id}/items/{item id} endpoint.
- **Upload Asset to Webflow**: This tool allows users to upload assets (files, images, etc.) to a webflow site.
- **Fulfill Order**: This tool allows you to mark an order as fulfilled in webflow's e-commerce system.
- **Unfulfill Order**: This tool allows you to mark a previously fulfilled order as unfulfilled in webflow.
